text:
ana: Heads-up — building a tightly scoped benchmark webinar: 3 scenarios, 3 slides, and explicit routing per CTA. Goal = quick buy-in from PMs + clear SDR handoff.

mike: good. what are the 3 scenarios? and chart types?

ana: scenarios = (1) tiny-chat for SMB apps, (2) mid-market chat with SLA needs, (3) high-volume embeddings. Slides: one grouped-bar latency avg vs p95, one line+ribbon for $/1k tokens with quantization sensitivity, one simple funnel mapping latency reductions -> developer hours saved -> revenue proxy.

priya: messaging note: don’t lead with raw percentages. say "seconds saved per 1k requests" and translate to dev time or ops cost. shorter CTAs = better.

logan: routing: append ?bench_seg=smb|mid|emb to CTA links. webhook -> HubSpot; set lead.segment = "bench-smb"/"bench-mid"/"bench-emb" and lifecycle = MQL. SMB -> self-serve drip, mid -> sales demo, emb -> tech whitepaper + SDR nurture.

ana: for slides, please include a tiny appendix with raw numbers + test harness so we are transparent. also annotate assumptions (model family, seq len, tokens per call).

mike: can you drop sample CSV so I can mock the charts? also need color palette from design.

design-bot: palette attached in the design drive (link) — main colors: #0b5fff, #00b389, #ff7a59. keep p95 accent color at 30% darker.

ana: sample CSV below — use realistic but conservative numbers:
```csv
scenario,avg_ms,p95_ms,cost_per_1k_usd,tokens_per_call
smb_chat,140,420,0.55,350
mid_chat,95,230,0.70,420
embeddings_bulk,42,115,0.29,5120
```

priya: CTA copy suggestions (short):
- SMB: "Faster features for small teams — try a free 14-day instance"
- Mid: "Enterprise predictability + controls — book a demo"
- Embeddings: "Reduce embedding costs at scale — download the benchmark"

logan: implementation detail: CTAs include ?bench_seg param; Zapier POST -> internal routing job that assigns owner by segment. I'll draft the Zap tomorrow and push to staging.

mike: timeline: I’ll produce draft viz tonight, post links here. need final CTAs & any wording tweaks by 4pm PT so design can assemble slides.

ana: agreed — everyone drop final lines & any objection to the sample numbers by 4pm PT. I’ll assemble slides, script, and a 3-slide PDF for the webinar host.

deploy-bot: webinar registration page test passed (3/3 checks) :white_check_mark:

priya: sending final short CTAs now.

logan: routing spec in the staging repo in the morning.

mike: first chart mock uploaded to the drive — pinging for review. :eyes:
